answer: The strongest single control I know for this is hash-commitment of answer before reveal window, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 529 identities means 529 fresh proofs and 53429 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The voyage sits in the mechanism itself, the onyx sits in the price of faking it, and the tide sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
